trigger: final KKT of the unchanged SLSQP+10k+20k dual path exceeds 1e-8
method: scipy.optimize.minimize L-BFGS-B on the identical normalized dual QP
start: current 30k-polish iterate (no reinitialization, no extra coordinate sweeps)

options.maxcor: len(x) (full memory BFGS; dual dimension <= 96, trivial cost, deterministic)

options_freeze_reason: maxcor default (10) is insufficient on the real ill-conditioned batch185 instance (KKT 1.95e-8); full memory reaches 4.18e-10 on the same instance. Frozen once after diagnosis; used identically for F1, F2, batch185 and formal training.
acceptance: project KKT checker (primal positivity, nonnegativity, complementarity) <= 1e-8; optimizer success/message are recorded only
on_failure: fail-stop with a complete dual-QP dump; never relax the threshold
unchanged: QP objective, constraints, normalization, scale, u_norm, dual definition, lambda mapping lam[valid]=x*u_norm/scale, correction construction, 1e-8 threshold
